summary: The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by providing investors with exposure to the price return of the CME CF Bitcoin Reference Rate — New York Variant ("BRRNY") ("Spot bitcoin") while attempting to limit downside risk through a laddered portfolio of four Calamos Bitcoin 90 Series Structured Alt Protection ETFs (the "Underlying ETFs"). The fund is non-diversified.
